name: What is the difference between a custom home and a semi-custom home?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a custom home and a semi-custom home?

acceptedAnswer.text: A custom home is entirely unique, designed from scratch to meet your specific vision, with no pre-existing plans. Every element, from the layout to the smallest finish, is chosen or created exclusively for you. In contrast, a semi-custom home involves selecting a base floor plan from a builder's existing portfolio, which can then be modified with a limited range of options for features, finishes, and sometimes minor layout adjustments. Custom homes offer unparalleled personalization, while semi-custom homes provide some flexibility within a more standardized framework.
acceptedAnswer.description: A custom home is uniquely designed from scratch, while a semi-custom home uses a base plan with limited customizable options.
